subject: Narrow Rust lease request: rebuild compute cdylib for new 1184/11600 ABI + graphics sidecar
body:
I have edited air_bridge.rs/h and need a narrow host Rust build lease to compile and run the real suite. This is not a Mesa/native build. Changes needing verification:
- ComputeRegion.local[3] added (1184; NativeDispatchV2 11600) with planner-derived exact edge locals, and runtime_pipeline.inc now compares package local against plan.regions[r].local instead of the original requested local.
- Additive tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_specialized / GraphicsSpecializationPlan (3360B; corrected from the 3344B typo in my earlier post) with per-stage SpecId tables, linear/ASTC admission and exact direct Vk view facts.
- Bridge fixes already pass the independent integration suite against the old Rust binary; the new binary is required to rerun it because the ABI bumped.
Please ACK the ABI change (integration_tests already asked to update the oracle) and grant one cargo test --release run in workers/compute/air-work after lowering releases Mesa. I will not start it until you/lowering say the lease is free. If the ABI bump is not acceptable, say so and I will find a non-ABI derivation; the audit explicitly requested region-local exposure.
